title: Herbaceous Crisp Polish Rice Pilaf
description: A one-pot Polish rice pilaf bursting with fragrant herbs and a subtle citrus zing, finished with a splash of rum for depth, ideal for macrobiotic dining.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the rosemary and thyme and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Stir in the rice and toast for 2 minutes, ensuring grains coat with oil.
Pour in the white wine and let it evaporate, stirring constantly.
Add the water, sea salt, and pepper, bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18 minutes.
Remove the pot from heat but keep it covered for 5 minutes to steam.
Fluff the rice with a fork, then stir in the melted butter and nutritional yeast.
Fold in the chopped parsley and lemon zest for brightness.
Serve hot, garnished with extra parsley if desired.
